fullPassage: Stanford psychology professor Dr. Carol Dweck is the internationally recognized pioneer of the concept of "growth mindset" as a way to continually grow, learn, and persevere in our efforts. Dweck found that kids who are told they're "smart" actually underperform in future tasks, by choosing easier tasks to avoid evidence that they are not smart, which Dweck calls having a "fixed mindset." In contrast, Dweck found, kids who are praised not for their smarts but for their effort develop what Dweck calls a "growth mindset." They learn that their effort is what led to their success, and if they continue to try, over time they'll improve and achieve more things. These kids end up taking on tougher things, and feel better about themselves. "Emphasizing effort gives a child a variable that they can control," Dweck has explained.

questions.passage: Stanford psychology professor Dr. Carol Dweck is the internationally recognized pioneer of the concept of "growth mindset" as a way to continually grow, learn, and persevere in our efforts. Dweck found that kids who are told they're "smart" actually underperform in future tasks, by choosing easier tasks to avoid evidence that they are not smart, which Dweck calls having a "fixed mindset." In contrast, Dweck found, kids who are praised not for their smarts but for their effort develop what Dweck calls a "growth mindset." They learn that their effort is what led to their success, and if they continue to try, over time they'll improve and achieve more things. These kids end up taking on tougher things, and feel better about themselves. "Emphasizing effort gives a child a variable that they can control," Dweck has explained.
questions.stem: 본문에서 Dweck이 노력을 칭찬받은 아이들이 기르게 된다고 말한 사고방식을 무엇이라 부르는가? 본문에서 찾아 영어 2단어로 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: growth mindset = 성장형 사고(방식)
det.analysis: 본문 'kids who are praised ~ for their effort develop what Dweck calls a "growth mindset"'에서 노력을 칭찬받은 아이들이 기르는 사고방식은 growth mindset(성장형 사고)이다.
det.tip: stem 단서: '노력을 칭찬받은 아이들이 기르는 사고방식' = growth mindset
